description: Deliberate test (object_lock_rejects_change): As an administrator, delete a locked log object version and shorten its retention. Both must be refused, and the version must still be there. The newest recorded run must have passed within 30 days

matrix_rows.gap: Run every 30 days by the operator and recorded, not every 3: the test changes or provokes the account, so it does not run unattended.
